description.zh-CN: 二选一：仅在输入框下方或仅在顶栏显示实时胶囊，点击就近弹出详情面板
description.en: Exclusive choice: show live capsule below the composer or in the topbar, opening the panel nearby on click

description.zh-CN: 在胶囊中实时显示流式估算速率 (~tok/s) 及完成后的精确速率
description.en: Show live estimated streaming rate (~tok/s) and final exact rate in the capsule

description.zh-CN: 定期读取当前会话记录并重算 Token 构成的时间间隔
description.en: Interval between transcript scans to recompute token breakdown

description.zh-CN: 支持绝对值（如 240K / 240000）或窗口百分比（如 50%）；达到后胶囊变橙提醒
description.en: Supports absolute tokens (e.g. 240K / 240000) or window percentage (e.g. 50%)

description.zh-CN: 支持绝对值（如 328K / 328000）或窗口百分比（如 70%）；达到后标记高风险断崖
description.en: Supports absolute tokens (e.g. 328K / 328000) or window percentage (e.g. 70%)

options.label: 预警快捷按钮 + 断崖自动压缩

description.zh-CN: 支持四档自由组合：仅提醒；仅开 A（达预警且空闲无草稿时在胶囊旁显示一键压缩）；仅开 B（达断崖等本步结束自动发 /compact，不强杀生成中回复）；A+B 同时开启
description.en: Supports all 4 combinations: remind only; A only (quick compact button when warn & idle & empty); B only (auto-send /compact after turn finishes at cliff); or A+B combined

description.zh-CN: 独立开关，默认关闭；开启后检测到缓存失效时无视上方策略与阈值，等本步结束立即自动发 /compact（发前暂存并恢复草稿）
description.en: Independent override (default OFF); ignores policy & thresholds when cache drop is detected and auto-sends /compact once idle
